main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads n and a list b from input, extracts and validates mountain-shaped blocks from the right end of b, appends their reconstructed group-based output to ans_lst, prints -1 and exits immediately if any block is invalid, and otherwise prints ans_lst line by line." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read integer n from input using I() and store it; n is not used elsewhere. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Read list b from input using LI() and store it. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND Initialize ans_lst as an empty list. RESULT ans_lst]
            [COMMAND While len(b) != 0, process one block from the right side of b. RESULT outer_loop]
            [COMMAND At the start of each outer-loop iteration, initialize lst as collections.deque([]), mx = 1, and phase = False. RESULT block_state]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, while len(b) != 0, pop the rightmost element nxt = b.pop(); update mx = max(mx, nxt); if mx == 1, append nxt to the left of lst. RESULT inner_loop_ones]
            [COMMAND Within the same inner loop, when mx > 1, set phase = phase or (nxt == 1). If phase is true and nxt != 1, restore nxt to b with b.append(nxt) and break the inner loop; otherwise append nxt to the left of lst. RESULT inner_loop_non_ones]
            [COMMAND After the inner loop ends, initialize ctn = True, up = True, now_mx = 0, now_mn = mx, and lenth = 0. RESULT validation_state]
            [COMMAND Run the validation loop over each x in lst: while up is true, if x >= now_mx, then set up = False when x == mx, otherwise increment lenth; if x < now_mx, set ctn = False and break. For each later element after up has become False, if x <= now_mn, update now_mn = min(now_mn, x); otherwise set ctn = False and break. RESULT validation_loop]
            [COMMAND Check validity: if not ctn or lenth + 1 < mx or lst[0] != 1, enter the invalid-block alternative flow; only continue to run-length processing when the block is valid. RESULT validation_result]
            [COMMAND For the valid block, build gr = [[k, len(list(g))] for k, g in itertools.groupby(lst)]. RESULT gr]
            [COMMAND Set com = len(lst), phase = False, down = False, now_len = 0, and i = 0. RESULT output_state]
            [COMMAND While com != 0, let nxt = lst[-1] be the current rightmost element of lst. RESULT last_element]
            [COMMAND Within the output loop, if phase is false, now_len + 1 < nxt, and down is false: inspect gr[i]. If gr[i][0] == mx, set down = True and decrement i; otherwise append gr[i][0] to ans_lst, increment now_len, decrement com and gr[i][1], and increment i. RESULT forward_group_use]
            [COMMAND Within the output loop, if phase is false, now_len + 1 < nxt, and down is true: if gr[i][1] == 0, decrement i; otherwise append gr[i][0] to ans_lst, increment now_len, decrement com and gr[i][1]. RESULT backward_group_use]
            [COMMAND Within the output loop, if phase is false and now_len + 1 >= nxt: append nxt to ans_lst, decrement com, pop lst, and set phase to True when nxt == mx. RESULT direct_pop_before_phase]
            [COMMAND Within the output loop, if phase is true and nxt == mx: append nxt to ans_lst, decrement com, and pop lst. RESULT direct_max_pop]
            [COMMAND Within the output loop, if phase is true, nxt != mx, and down is false: if gr[i][0] == mx, set down = True and decrement i; otherwise append gr[i][0] to ans_lst, decrement com and gr[i][1], and increment i. RESULT phase_forward_group_use]
            [COMMAND Within the output loop, if phase is true, nxt != mx, and down is true: if gr[i][1] == 0, decrement i; otherwise append gr[i][0] to ans_lst, decrement com and gr[i][1]. RESULT phase_backward_group_use]
            [COMMAND After com reaches 0, this block is fully appended to ans_lst; repeat the outer loop if b is non-empty. RESULT block_complete]
            [COMMAND After the outer loop finishes, print ans_lst elements separated by newlines. RESULT printed_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Block validation fails because ctn is False, or lenth + 1 < mx, or lst[0] != 1.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print -1 to standard output. RESULT printed_minus_one]
            [COMMAND Exit the program immediately with status 0. RESULT exited]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
